title: Can Multimodal LLMs solve complex tasks?
reading: The slide poses a question about whether multimodal LLMs can handle complex, compound tasks, illustrated with a concrete example prompt: building a database that links runner faces to their corresponding bib numbers. This implies a pipeline requiring face detection, text/number recognition on bibs, and association between the two within images.

concepts.name: Multimodal LLMs
concepts.why_it_matters: The slide assumes familiarity with models that process both images and text.

concepts.name: Complex compound vision tasks
concepts.why_it_matters: Tasks like face-to-bib-number association require chaining detection, OCR, and reasoning.
